Title: SplitBrain.AI — Project Overview
Content: SplitBrain.AI is a distributed home AI orchestrator that routes inference tasks between two local machines (Machine A and Machine B) via MCP. Node A (fast, RTX 5060) handles interactive latency-sensitive workloads; Node B (deep, GTX 1080 8 GB) handles long-context reasoning. All capabilities are exposed as MCP tools through Orchestrator.Mcp on port 5100 (streamable HTTP) and stdio (VS Code / VS 2026 integration). The system uses VRAM-aware, queue-aware, context-aware routing with role-based scoring.
